Game Overview

At its heart, Crazy Farmer Challenge Pro is a racing game about race through 18 wacky farm-themed levels in your high-speed wheelchair. Crazy Farmer Challenge Pro blends adrenaline-pumping wheelchair races with unexpected obstacles, offering uniquely delightful chaos. Power through haystacks and mud splashes, listening to immersive sounds, as you battle time to become the ultimate farm racing champion.
